Hiking with elevated levels of govt debt it is stimulative. Banks get paid more on their reserves, and rentiers get paid more on their T-bills. The net effect is more consumption, especially of financial assets.

The net effect is an increase of the quantity of money even as its price increases. This is why financial assets will continue to rise.
